glosses: bedsheet, sheet (a large, rectangular piece of fabric used as bedding on top of a mattress or to cover someone sleeping)
shroud, winding sheet (a cloth or tunic used to wrap a corpse for burial)
expanse, sheet, surface (a wide, thin surface or any smooth, flat expanse compared to a bedsheet due to its appearance)

examples.en: The sheet is on the bed.

examples.text: Havia dois lençóis sobre a cama.
examples.en: Two sheets were on the bed.

examples.text: Ela pôs lençóis limpos na cama.
examples.en: She put clean sheets on the bed.
